name: SDN Host FlatSQL Query Node
description: Generalized engine query node wrapping the storage.flatsql_query_stream hostcall. Method "query": input "query" JSON {"sql":"...","params":[{"t":"i64|f64|str|bool|null|bytes","v":...}]} -> the ALIGNED size-prefixed FlatBuffer result stream passes through VERBATIM on "stream". This is the generic engine query node; data-source/retrieval remains the profile-aware variant (epoch profiles, SDS CAQ request envelopes). Host support: server-only today — storage.flatsql_query_stream is served by the Go node (sdn-server modulert/caps/storage.go, capability storage_query); the SDK BrowserHost storage adapter exposes storage.query/write/delete but not the flatsql stream ops. TRANSITIONAL: flatsql is becoming a component DEPENDENCY with direct in-wasm linkage in a later task; this node uses the hostcall bridge until that lands. v0.2.0 adds sandbox_query (gateway loop G.5): the PUBLIC /api/v1/query surface over the policy-mediated READ-ONLY storage.query_sandboxed hostcall — the engine enforces the sandbox IN-WASM (authorizer over record tables/shadow tables/unified views, single-statement SELECT-only, statement timeout, row/byte caps; host config gateway.query). sort/limit/profile request params compose the effective SQL in this node; storage.query_surface serves the discoverable queryable-surface listing (tables/views/columns + effective caps) for GET.

externalInterfaces.description: Host FlatSQL engine-native query streaming (storage.flatsql_query_stream). Served by the Go node today; browser-side flatsql stream ops are not exposed by the SDK BrowserHost storage adapter (server-only until flatsql ships as an in-wasm component dependency).

acceptedTypeSets.description: UTF-8 JSON bytes (aligned-binary wire format): {"sql":"..." (required),"params":[{"t":"i64|f64|str|bool|null|bytes","v":...}]}. Tagged params forward verbatim to the host op (decoded by sdn-server decodeTaggedParams).

ALIGNED size-prefixed FlatBuffer stream (schema depends on the query) passed through verbatim from storage.flatsql_query_stream. SDK manifest rules cannot express a generic aligned-binary type, so the port declares the generic flatbuffer ref; runtime frames carry the aligned-binary wire format in their TAB descriptors (requiredAlignment 8), matching data-source/retrieval's rows port.

outputPorts.description: Verbatim aligned size-prefixed FlatBuffer result stream.

methods.description: Executes a FlatSQL query through the transitional storage.flatsql_query_stream hostcall bridge and streams the raw aligned result verbatim.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The decision forwarded verbatim on success, or rewritten to route=error with status (400 validation / 406 projection-as-flatbuffer / 422 timeout|row-cap|byte-cap / 502 host failure), error message and machine-readable code.

Response body: aligned size-prefixed record frames verbatim / host body-reference descriptor (fb path), engine-assembled bare-array JSON with schema-exact column keys (projection results), or the queryable-surface JSON object (GET). Absent on error decisions and on the full-record json path (which rides the stream port).

outputPorts.description: Body frame for http-respond (absent when the stream port carries the result or on errors).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Weak FNV-1a-64 entity tag (W/"fnv1a64-<16 hex>") over the raw result stream (shared by both encodings) or over the JSON payload for rows/surface results.
Full-record result stream on the json path, fed to foundation/omm-json for the bare-array presentation.

outputPorts.description: json path only: the raw record stream for the JSON presentation adapter.

methods.description: Execute one sandboxed public query (gateway loop G.5). route=public_query: compose the effective SQL (raw sql wrapped with validated sort/limit, or a named epoch profile nearest|as_of|forward over the unified OMM view with default epoch=now) and call the READ-ONLY storage.query_sandboxed host op (want=stream + body-ref for flatbuffer, want=auto for json). route=query_surface: storage.query_surface listing. Sandbox rejections map to 400/406/422; the engine enforces read-only/single-statement/timeout/caps IN-WASM.
